name: t23-g3-residency-disk
description: T23 / G3 row 7 item 2 (increment 31). Identical scene/edit script/budget to t23-g3-residency, but the server backs its residency pass with the real on-disk DiskBrickBacking (--residency-disk-backing) instead of the in-process MemoryBacking default. Proves end to end, through a real cargo xtask scenario multi-process run (not just the library-level integration tests increment 28 added), that: (1) the committed world / agreed canonical hash is unchanged from the in-memory-backed run; (2) a world.db-adjacent residency.db file is created and non-empty (ServeSummary.residency_backing_disk_bytes reported as Some(n>0)); (3) a cold-restarted server re-opening the same residency.db still converges to the agreed hash (restart_check, reused with matching residency + disk-backing flags on the restarted server).
